title: Dev Opportunity Radar #22: $50K Basis Fellowship, Perplexity AI Research Fellowship, and FC Barcelona Analytics Hackathon
why_read: A roundup of funding/fellowship opportunities with little technical content, useful mainly as a career resource newsletter.
analysis: This is a weekly curated list of fellowships, hackathons, and resources aimed at developers and researchers, such as a $50K fellowship and a sports analytics hackathon. It contains no technical content itself, functioning purely as an aggregator of external opportunities. It may be useful to readers looking for funding or events but offers nothing in terms of engineering substance.
